conversations.name: Kobie Fuller
conversations.subject: Circularo - Trust Infrastructure for the Agentic AI Era
conversations.body:
Hi Kobie,

I’m the co-founder and CEO of circularo.com, a profitable, bootstrapped digital trust platform headquartered in Dubai.

We’ve grown to ~$3M in recurring revenue with no external capital, building sovereign-scale digital signature and trusted transaction infrastructure used across UAE government and major enterprise environments.

We’re now extending that foundation toward trusted execution for the agentic AI era — connecting identity, authority, approvals and verifiable evidence for actions taken by humans and AI agents.

Given your focus on AI and software at Upfront, I thought our story might be relevant. I’ll be in LA from October 8 for a week and would be happy to meet in person if useful.

Best,
Josef
+61 421 817 894
josef.neumann@circularo.com

conversations.name: Alex Neo
conversations.subject: Circularo × Singtel Innov8 — digital trust and strategic investment
conversations.body:
Hi Alex, 

I’m Josef Neumann co-founder of Circularo.com.

Our digital-trust solutions help governments and enterprises in the GCC and EU manage approvals, digital signatures and verifiable document transactions. 

Our broader direction is to extend that foundation into trusted execution: how organisations authorise consequential actions and retain reliable evidence, whether those actions originate from people, enterprise systems or AI agents.

I’d like to explore a strategic investment relationship with Singtel Innov8, combining our sovereign digital-trust platform with your enterprise and telecom ecosystem. 

Would you be open to a brief introductory call?

Josef 

Josef Neumann
+61 421 817 894
josef.neumann@circularo.com
